hook.name: RhmiFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/RHMI pools that charges a fixed ETH trade tax (immutable, capped at 4%) on every swap, routing fees directly to a treasury address. Fee collection is split across beforeSwap (ETH-specified swaps) and afterSwap (ETH-unspecified swaps) using return deltas; no owner or admin controls exist.
